newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, milder fluctuations.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, milder fluctuations.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed on Thursday, with marginal price fluctuations and food processor Podravka accounting for most of the trading.
* Volume slightly up at 19,902 units, turnover down at 7.8 million kuna.
* Six of eleven active issues rose, three fell and two were unchanged.
* Biggest gainer Zagrebacka Banka C-series bearer shares rose 50 kuna to 600, selling only two shares.
* Top decliner hotelier Arena edged down 10 kuna to 160, with 68 units sold.
* Most active Podravka added five kuna to 305 on volume of 16,716 shares.
